title: Optimal Stratified Allocation for Rare-Event Onset Forecasting in Dependent Sequences
summary: Let a finite population of n labelled examples carry a class-weighted loss, with pi*n in a rare positive class weighted by N0/N1. We study estimation of total risk from a subsample K << n under designs allocating K0 and K1 draws to the two strata. We derive the exact finite-population variance of the weighted risk estimator under class-conditional sampling without replacement and solve for the optimal allocation.
